observations.description: Black nylon-band G-SHOCK with a neutral/gray digital face and Tough Solar.

source_status.casio_canada_archive: Indexed Casio Canada archive description corroborates black nylon and Module 2184; retained as citation provenance only.
source_status.parts_catalog: Retrieved supplier page lists 2003, Module 2184, Band/Cloth 10124363 and Bezel/Resin 10071461.
source_status.naming_guide: Casio America general guide associates G with G-SHOCK, B with nylon and 1 with black; it lists trailing V as digital dial code and warns of exceptions. This is not an exclusive export-suffix definition for this exact model.

family_prefix.meaning: G-SHOCK line for this exact G-2300B reference.

series_number.meaning: 2300 model series, a Tough Solar digital watch using Module 2184; 2300 is not the module number or production year.

post_series_modifier.meaning: Band/configuration variation for this G-2300B model: nylon/cloth band and the supplied Velcro-adapter configuration. The parts source lists 2003 versus 2000 for G2300-1V; a later release-wave reading is contextual, not a universal B definition or an electronics upgrade.

color_design_code.meaning: Black primary case/band color code; the face is described as neutral/gray.

regional_reference.meaning: Trailing catalog suffix in G-2300B-1V. Owner-supplied regional/export interpretation is qualified: Casio America also lists V as a digital-dial code. An exclusive export-market meaning is not confirmed for this model.

worldwide_evidence.uncertainty: Supplied worldwide research; pending independent archived-source verification. Listing/announcement dates are not first-release dates. Exact reference only; no cross-variant inheritance.

source_status.naming_guide: Casio America general guide associates G with G-SHOCK, B with nylon and 1 with black; it lists trailing V as digital dial code and warns of exceptions. This is not an exclusive export-suffix definition for this exact model.

family_prefix.meaning: G-SHOCK line for this exact G-2300B reference.

series_number.meaning: 2300 model series, a Tough Solar digital watch using Module 2184; 2300 is not the module number or production year.

post_series_modifier.meaning: Band/configuration variation for this G-2300B model: nylon/cloth band and the supplied Velcro-adapter configuration. The parts source lists 2003 versus 2000 for G2300-1V; a later release-wave reading is contextual, not a universal B definition or an electronics upgrade.

color_design_code.meaning: Black primary case/band color code; the face is described as neutral/gray.

regional_reference.meaning: Trailing catalog suffix in G-2300B-1V. Owner-supplied regional/export interpretation is qualified: Casio America also lists V as a digital-dial code. An exclusive export-market meaning is not confirmed for this model.
